headline: Amazon S3 ingestion adds an sqs:GetQueueAttributes prerequisite; 195 licence notes reworded to "connector"
summary_md:
- **Amazon S3 collection gained a prerequisite**: `GetQueueAttributes` was added to the minimum SQS permissions on all six S3 pages, in the prose and in the sample IAM and queue access policies.
- **195 licence notes changed "This sub-capability is available…" to "This connector is available…"** — a noun swap only; not one entitlement list gained or lost a product.
- **347 pages gained `description` front matter**, and 59 vendor landing pages that were bare headings now list the articles beneath them.
- Everything sits in the Cortex XSIAM data sources and connectors section; 420 files changed, all modifications — nothing added, deleted or renamed.

highlights.title: Amazon S3 ingestion now documents sqs:GetQueueAttributes as a minimum permission
highlights.detail: The permission was added to the prerequisite list, to the IAM assumed-role policy, and to the SQS access-policy sample, so a tightly-scoped existing policy no longer matches what the docs require.

highlights.title: "Sub-capability" became "connector" in every licensing note
highlights.detail: 195 pages swapped the noun; the licence lists behind it are identical before and after, so no data source changed which products entitle it.

highlights.title: 59 vendor landing pages now list their child articles
highlights.detail: Pages that held only a heading gained a "Here are the articles in this section" index — Microsoft alone picked up 21 links, making its sub-pages reachable without the sidebar.

highlights.title: 347 pages gained YAML description front matter
highlights.detail: A one-line description block was prepended across the section, which is metadata rather than a change to any documented procedure.

highlights.title: The Cisco ASA page title lost a stray backtick
highlights.detail: "Cisco ASA firewalls and AnyConnect`" became "Cisco ASA firewalls and AnyConnect", and the XSIAM navigation manifest was updated to match.

items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: Adds GetQueueAttributes to the minimum SQS permissions for manual S3 collection.
The assumed-role IAM policy sample now grants sqs:GetQueueAttributes alongside DeleteMessage and ChangeMessageVisibility.
CloudTrail ingestion adds GetQueueAttributes to both the prerequisites and the SQS access-policy __receiver_statement sample.
Generic S3 log ingestion adds GetQueueAttributes to the prerequisites and the queue access-policy sample.
VPC flow log ingestion adds GetQueueAttributes to the minimum SQS permissions.
Route 53 log ingestion adds GetQueueAttributes to the minimum SQS permissions.
Page title corrected from "Cisco ASA firewalls and AnyConnect`"; the XSIAM navigation manifest changed with it.
The Microsoft landing page, previously a bare heading, now indexes all 21 Microsoft and Azure data source pages.
OpenText landing page gained an index of its child articles.
PagerDuty landing page gained an index of its child articles.
Gained front matter; the collection-method table was reflowed with no change to its content.
